image_description: An underwater scene featuring a hammerhead shark swimming towards the left. The shark has a distinct cephalofoil (hammer head) with eyes at the tips. The body is greyish-white. In the background, there are several smaller fish and blue water. There is visible text overlay on the left side of the image.
